description: The image displays two side-by-side pie charts that represent the distribution of four outcome categories, as indicated by a shared horizontal legend positioned at the top. The four categories are "Atomic Skill Fail" (dark teal), "Correct" (medium teal), "Reason Error" (light teal), and "Question Misunderstood" (off-white). The left pie chart is dominated by the "Atomic Skill Fail" category at 68.0%, followed by "Correct" and "Reason Error," both at 12.0%, and "Question Misunderstood" at 8.0%. The right pie chart illustrates a different distribution where the "Correct" category is the largest at 55.0%, followed by "Reason Error" at 21.0%, "Question Misunderstood" at 14.0%, and "Atomic Skill Fail" at 10.0%. Both charts include explicit percentage labels positioned directly inside their respective slices and feature a subtle 3D shadow effect along the bottom edge, though no individual slices are exploded or visually offset. Visually, the slices in both charts are arranged in a consistent clockwise sequence starting from the top (12 o'clock position) with "Correct," followed by "Atomic Skill Fail," "Question Misunderstood," and "Reason Error," rather than being ordered strictly by descending or ascending size.
